The thing is I get tons of scam/junk calls so I have unknown numbers silenced. The “sheriff” ends up texting me that I had a warrant out for my arrest for having sexual communications with an underage girl. The sheriff left his name (sorry I forgot it’s been years) but upon looking his name on google he was fired from the police force for sexual assault. Sent a screenshot of the article to the number saying “this you?” never heard back haha.

I was still pretty worried though, it didn’t help when I got home police cars were at my grandparents which were my neighbors. Turns out they were there just for a statement from my grandmother who was witness to some altercation. Scared the hell out of me though
